description: This file contains internal utility classes and extensions for .NET Standard and .NET Framework, including compatibility shims for newer C# features like Index and Range, and custom attributes for nullability annotations.

classes.name: System.Runtime.CompilerServices.IsExternalInit
classes.description: Internal static class required for init-only setters in older .NET Standard and Framework versions.

classes.name: System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.MaybeNullAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating a value may be null.

classes.name: System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.MaybeNullWhenAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating a parameter may be null depending on the return value.

classes.name: System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.NotNullWhenAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating a parameter is not null when the method returns a specified boolean value.

classes.name: System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.DoesNotReturnAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating a method does not return.

classes.name: System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.DoesNotReturnIfAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating a parameter causes a method not to return if it has a specific boolean value.

classes.name: System.Index
classes.description: Represents an index into a collection from the start or end, supporting C# index syntax.

classes.name: System.Range
classes.description: Represents a range with start and end indexes, supporting C# range syntax.

classes.name: System.StringExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension method for string.Contains with StringComparison parameter.

methods.name: System.StringExtensions.Contains
methods.description: Extension method for string.Contains that accepts StringComparison.
